notes: No command channel exists. PixelTail's own Windows and Linux dedicated-condo guides document no RCON, no admin API and no server console: admins are declared with AdminSteamID under [Administration] in Tower/Saved/Config/<Platform>Server/TowerServer.ini, and they kick, ban and set per-player permissions from the in-game condo scoreboard (Settings > Player Permissions, which lists 'Kick Players' and 'Ban Players' as permissions - see the official wiki). There is no documented way to list players, broadcast or kick from outside the game client. Bans persist in TowerBans.ini beside TowerServer.ini, as lines 'SteamID=<64-bit id>,0' under a [Bans] section; the guides say the file can be edited by hand, but do not say whether a running server re-reads it, so assume a restart. Disagreement: Legion Hosting's knowledgebase publishes a kick/ban/unban/mute/players/say/status command list for Tower Unite with no primary source; nothing from PixelTail, the official wiki or the Steam 'Server Administration' guide mentions any such command, and it fits the generic fabricated hosting-blog pattern - treat it as wrong. A 2019 AMP template request (CubeCoders/AMPTemplates#230) speculates 'Supports RCON/Console input? I think yes' but links a setup thread that mentions neither, so it is not evidence. appId 439660 is the separate 'Tower Unite Dedicated Server' Steam app; the game itself is 394690.
